title: Mirror composition of function vectors
hypothesis: For two demonstrated mappings that compose on held-out inputs, layer-factorized application of two extracted function vectors will improve held-out composition accuracy over raw same-layer vector addition at the same or lower intervention payload cost.
physical_object: one frozen GPT-2 model with two fixed residual-stream intervention sites at layers 4 and 8
mirror_coordinate: ordered pair of task function vectors (f1,f2); compare same-layer sum against role/layer-factorized code
logical_multiplicity: composed fruit-to-color and color-to-shape mappings yielding fruit-to-shape outputs
controls: direct in-context demonstrations of both mappings

task.support: four fruit->color pairs and four color->shape pairs covering held-out fruit intermediates
metrics: composition accuracy vs direct ICL/raw sum/ablations

development.allowed: development used only to check serialization and estimate basis-free vector variability; layer sites and arithmetic/factorized conditions fixed a priori

storage.authority: actual serialized function-vector intervention payload; report pinned model+tokenizer base bytes separately
paid_objects: both full task vectors or factorized vectors
all per-task metadata and decoder state

success_gate: Direct composition ICL exceeds 12.5% chance in every fresh world, and factorized layer application beats raw f1+f2 by >=5 percentage points in every world without lowering direct ICL; include payload bytes and ablations.
failure_gate: Direct composition ICL is at chance, extracted vectors do not improve query-only, or layer-factorized code does not beat raw vector addition at equal bytes.
boundaries: One small GPT-2 checkpoint and synthetic mapping composition only; not a broad NLP or GPT-J Function Vectors reproduction.
No model weight training; support demonstrations define tasks.
Function composition count is not capacity; held-out exact task behavior is primary.

amendment_before_fresh.reason: The tokenizer smoke test found one shape label split into multiple tokens, which would make single-next-token scoring invalid.
amendment_before_fresh.change: Replace hexagon with the one-token label sphere; no task structure or success gate changed.
